summary: Personalis, Inc. filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing that the HSR waiting period for its pending acquisition by Tempus AI, Inc. expired at 11:59 p.m. ET on October 2, 2026. The July 20, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger contemplates a two-step reverse triangular merger (Merger Sub I into Personalis, then Personalis into Merger Sub II), leaving Personalis a wholly owned Tempus subsidiary. Tempus refiled its HSR notification September 2, 2026 after a voluntary August 31 withdrawal. Remaining gating items: Personalis stockholder approval at a virtual meeting (date TBD) and other customary conditions. Watch the proxy/S-4 timeline and any shareholder dissent.
